name: Anzus
cooked: From a wallet user’s point of view, each level may be more useful if it also has a clear recommended action—for example, no action needed, avoid reusing the address, or move the funds when a safer option is available. Is that guidance intended to be standardized, or left to each wallet? Otherwise, different wallets could show very different warnings for the same situation.
